# Third-Party Licenses — Sudoku

The App bundles open-source software and assets. The full, authoritative license
text for every Dart/Flutter package is available inside the App at
**Settings → Legal → Open-source licenses** (generated by Flutter's
`showLicensePage`). This file is a human-readable summary.

## Runtime packages (pub.dev)

| Package | License |
|---|---|
| Flutter SDK, `cupertino_icons` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `google_mobile_ads` | Apache-2.0 (Google Mobile Ads SDK for Android/iOS bundled under its own SDK terms) |
| `shared_preferences` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `in_app_update` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `package_info_plus` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `url_launcher` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `http` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `phosphor_icons` | MIT (Phosphor Icons — MIT) |
| `lottie` | Apache-2.0 (Lottie for Flutter) |
| `audioplayers` | MIT |

## Bundled assets

| Asset | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| Poppins font family (`assets/fonts/`) | Indian Type Foundry / Jonny Pinhorn | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Lottie animation files (`assets/motion/`) | Original work commissioned for this App | © Holash Chand, all rights reserved |
| Sound effects (`assets/sfx/`) | See per-file attribution in `assets/sfx/CREDITS.txt` | As stated there |
| App icon and artwork (`assets/icon/`) | Original work | © Holash Chand, all rights reserved |

## Notes

- The Google Mobile Ads SDK is also subject to the
  [Google APIs Terms of Service](https://developers.google.com/terms) and the
  [AdMob Publisher Policies](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6128543).
- If any `assets/sfx/` file is CC-BY licensed, attribution is reproduced in
  `assets/sfx/CREDITS.txt` and must remain in the shipped build.
